product-build.title: Product Build
product-build.forWho: From a great idea to a fully developed digital product.
product-build.description: We turn your idea into a working digital product. From the initial concept and development to launch and ongoing maintenance. Whether it's a web application, e-commerce platform or custom website, we handle the entire process.
product-build.intro: You bring the idea. We own the build, end to end, from a blank page to a live product, plus the updates after launch.
product-build.whatItIs: Product build is our full-delivery mode: you hand us the idea and we take ownership of turning it into a working product. Web apps, e-commerce, custom sites; we handle the design, the engineering, the deployment, and the maintenance that keeps it running. You don't need an in-house team or a technical co-founder; that's our job.
howItWorks: We start by understanding the idea, the users, and what success looks like, then scope a realistic first version.
You get a clear proposal and timeline before we write code, so there are no surprises on budget or deadline.
We build in short cycles and show you working software early, adapting as your input comes in.
After launch we stay on for updates, fixes and improvements. The product keeps evolving, and so do we.
product-build.metaTitle: Product Build - C-Shine Digital | From Idea to Live Product
product-build.metaDescription: Have an idea but no team to build it? We own the whole build (web apps, e-commerce and custom sites) from a blank page to a live product, plus updates after launch.

it-partner.forWho: One reliable partner for all your digital needs.
it-partner.description: From your website and brand identity to hosting, domains, email and technical support. We take care of the digital side of your business, so you can focus on what matters most: running your business.
it-partner.intro: One partner for everything digital: website, brand, hosting, email and day-to-day support, so you can focus on your business.
it-partner.whatItIs: Full IT partner is our all-in mode: we become your complete digital and IT function. Website and brand identity, hosting, domains and email, and the ongoing support that keeps it all working, handled by one team you can actually reach. Instead of juggling a web agency, a hosting provider and an IT helpdesk, you have a single point of contact for everything digital.
howItWorks: We take stock of what you already have (website, domains, email, tools) and map what needs building, fixing or replacing.
We set up and run the essentials: brand, site, hosting, domains and email, all under one roof.
Day-to-day support means you have someone to call when something breaks or needs to change, with no ticket queue to a stranger.
As your business grows, we adapt the setup (new pages, new tools, new needs) without you having to re-hire.
it-partner.metaTitle: Full IT Partner - C-Shine Digital | Your Complete Digital & IT Function
it-partner.metaDescription: Want one partner for everything digital? Website, brand, hosting, domains, email and day-to-day support: your complete IT function, handled by one Belgian team.

embedded.forWho: Extra technical expertise, directly within your team.
embedded.description: We embed with your developers (frontend, backend, DevOps) and ship alongside you. Senior hands, no long onboarding, flexible on stack.
embedded.intro: Extra engineering firepower that plugs straight into your team: senior hands, no long onboarding, flexible on stack.
embedded.whatItIs: Embedded developer is our team-augmentation mode: instead of owning a project, we join yours. We embed with your existing developers (frontend, backend, DevOps) and ship alongside them, following your processes and your stack. It's for in-house teams that need capacity or a specific skill for a while, without the cost and lead time of a permanent hire.
howItWorks: We match senior people to the gap you actually have, not whoever happens to be free.
We work inside your workflow: your tools, your repos, your standup. We adapt to you, not the other way around.
No long onboarding. The aim is to be productive in your codebase within days, not weeks.
Engage per project or on a rolling contract, and scale the involvement up or down as your roadmap shifts.

FAQ.title: Frequently Asked Questions
FAQ.intro: Common questions about working with C-Shine Digital

items.question: What does a website or web app cost?
items.answer: It depends on what you need, so we don’t work with fixed packages. After a short, free conversation about your project you get a clear proposal with a fixed price for the agreed scope, before any work starts. Small projects are just as welcome as large ones.

items.question: How long does a project take?
items.answer: That depends entirely on the project: a few pages are something else than a webshop or a custom platform. Your proposal includes a realistic timeline, so you know where you stand before we start.

items.question: Who owns the domain, the code and the content?
items.answer: The domain is always yours. As long as we manage your website, we keep the technical management, including the code and the hosting. If you want to take over the management yourself or move to another party, we transfer everything to you.

items.question: What happens after launch? Is maintenance included?
items.answer: We offer maintenance for a fixed yearly fee. It covers basic maintenance, security updates and quick small questions. New features or larger changes are quoted separately, so there are no surprises.

items.question: Which technologies do you work with?
items.answer: We’re not tied to one technology and choose what fits your project: for example Next.js, React, Angular, Java with Spring Boot, Shopify, or a CMS such as Contentful or Strapi.

items.question: Do you only work in Limburg?
items.answer: No. We’re based in Zutendaal (Limburg) but work for clients across Belgium and Europe, remotely or on site.

items.question: Can I hire you for just one thing?
items.answer: Yes. Next to a full build, a complete IT partnership or an embedded developer, we’re happy to take on a standalone job, such as a logo, hosting and email, or a single feature.

AboutPage.title: A Belgian studio built around flexibility
AboutPage.subtitle: C-Shine Digital exists to be whatever a project needs, and to be the same reliable, senior partner in every one of those shapes.
story: Most digital companies do one thing and try to make every client fit it. We built C-Shine the other way around. For one client we’re a developer embedded in their team; for another we’re the entire IT function (website, brand, hosting and support); for a third we take an idea from a blank page all the way to a launched product.

What stays constant is the standard: senior work, direct communication, and the right technology for the job. We’re small on purpose, and it’s why you always work with the people actually doing the work, and why we can move quickly without layers in between.
